name: Quandary / McCullough Gulch
notes: Cristo Couloir from Blue Lakes dam; East Ridge from Hwy 9 lot.

name: Kite Lake (DeCaLiBron)
notes: Road to Kite Lake closed in winter/spring; start near Alma adds miles.

name: Fourmile Creek (Sherman)
notes: Iowa Gulch / Fourmile; upper road often gated.

name: Stevens Gulch (Grays/Torreys)
notes: Bakerville road off I-70 unplowed; adds ~3 mi each way.

name: Guanella Pass (Bierstadt)
notes: Pass plowed from Georgetown side most of season.

name: Echo Lake (Blue Sky/Evans)
notes: Mt. Evans Rd closed; long approach to Summit Lake bowls.

name: Longs Peak TH
notes: RMNP; ski lines (Keplinger's/Notch) are late-season, high consequence.

name: Crags / Devils Playground (Pikes)
notes: Pikes ski descents are rare/marginal; continuity poor.

name: Black Cloud / SE Elbert
notes: South/Box Creek approaches to Elbert east lines.

name: Mt. Massive TH (North Halfmoon)
notes: Halfmoon road; SE/East faces.

name: North Cottonwood (Harvard/Columbia)
notes: Shared TH for Harvard and Columbia.

name: La Plata TH (Hwy 82)
notes: NW Couloir / Ellingwood Ridge access.

name: Baldwin Gulch (Antero)
notes: Long 4WD road to Antero; gated low in season.

name: Blank Gulch (Shavano/Tabeguache)
notes: Angel of Shavano TH; shared for the Shavano/Tabeguache linkup.

name: Mt. Princeton Radio Towers
notes: Road to towers usually gated; long road walk in winter.

name: Denny Creek (Yale)
notes: Yale SW/East slopes.

name: Missouri Gulch (Belford/Oxford/Missouri)
notes: Shared TH for the Belford/Oxford/Missouri linkup.

name: South Winfield (Huron)
notes: Winfield road gated; adds road miles in winter.

name: Half Moon (Holy Cross)
notes: Tigiwon road gated; Cross Couloir is a committing N line.

name: Nellie Creek (Uncompahgre)
notes: 4WD road gated; long approach in season.

name: Matterhorn Creek (Wetterhorn)
notes: Wetterhorn SE/East; rocky summit block.

name: Yankee Boy Basin (Sneffels)
notes: Camp Bird road gated; Snake/Birthday couloirs.

name: Silver Creek (Redcloud/Sunshine)
notes: Cinnamon Pass road; shared for Redcloud/Sunshine linkup.

name: American Basin (Handies)
notes: Handies E/SW; Cinnamon Pass access.

name: Stewart Creek (San Luis)
notes: Long, remote NE-slope approach.

name: Needleton (Chicago Basin)
notes: Access historically via Durango-Silverton train; multi-day basecamp for Eolus/Sunlight/Windom. Train schedule is its own constraint.

name: Navajo Lake / Kilpacker (Mt. Wilson)
notes: Mt. Wilson N Face / Boxcar.

name: Rock of Ages (Wilson Peak)
notes: Wilson Peak SW/W.

name: South Colony Lakes (Crestones/Humboldt)
notes: 2WD lot; 4WD road gated. Shared for Crestone Peak/Needle and Humboldt.

name: Willow Creek (Kit Carson/Challenger)
notes: From Crestone town; Outward Bound Couloir basin.

name: Lake Como road (Blanca massif)
notes: Infamous brutal road; long approach to Blanca/Ellingwood/Little Bear.

name: Lily Lake / Huerfano (Lindsey)
notes: Huerfano road gated; NW gully.

name: Cielo Vista Ranch (Culebra)
notes: PRIVATE access -- must pre-book a ranch permit; not a walk-up. Access, not avalanche, is often the binding constraint here.

name: Maroon Lake (Bells/Pyramid)
notes: Maroon Creek road closed at T-Lazy-7 in season; long approach. Shared for Maroon/North Maroon and (separately) Pyramid.

name: Snowmass Creek (Snowmass Mtn)
notes: Long valley approach; East Face / S Face.

name: Capitol Creek (Capitol)
notes: Capitol Lake basin; N Face / K2 ridge -- the hardest objective.

name: Castle Creek / Montezuma Basin (Castle)
notes: Montezuma road gated; NE couloir.
